definitions.explanation: pleasantly fresh and clean, giving a feeling of renewal or clarity

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{空気|くうき}が{清々|すがすが}しい。
{試合|しあい}に{負|ま}けたが、{清々|すがすが}しい{気持|きも}ちだ。
examples.english: I lost the match, but I feel refreshed.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{清々|すがすが}しい{笑顔|えがお}に{好感|こうかん}を{持|も}った。
examples.english: I was drawn to his fresh, honest smile.

notes:
{清々|すがすが}しい describes a pleasant, refreshing quality that makes one feel clean and renewed.

KANJI NOTE:
- Uses reduplication of {清|すが} for emphasis
- The kanji {清|すが} means "pure, clear"
- Often written in hiragana

FORMS:
- Attributive: {清々|すがすが}しい + noun
- Predicate: {清々|すがすが}しい
- Adverbial: {清々|すがすが}しく
- Noun form: {清々|すがすが}しさ (refreshingness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清々|すがすが}しい{朝|あさ} (refreshing morning)
- {清々|すがすが}しい{気持|きも}ち (refreshed feeling)
- {清々|すがすが}しい{笑顔|えがお} (fresh smile)
- {清々|すがすが}しい{風|かぜ} (refreshing breeze)
- {清々|すがすが}しい{気分|きぶん} (invigorated mood)

USAGE NOTES:
- Often used for morning air, post-exercise feelings, or after completing something
- Can describe both physical sensations and emotional states
- Also used for personalities that are honest and unpretentious

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {爽|さわ}やか (refreshing - lighter nuance)
- {爽快|そうかい} (exhilarating - more intense)
- {新鮮|しんせん} (fresh - more neutral)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {清々|すがすが}しくなかったら
